launcher.notes: KINETRIX LAUNCHER 3.0.2 - LINUX LAUNCH FIXED FOR REAL: THE LAUNCHER NOW CARRIES THE GAME'S GRAPHICS LIBRARIES. Linux players on minimal desktops (i3, sway, X-only images, some Wayland setups) were stopped by 'Cannot launch - this Linux is missing system libraries the game needs: libXcursor.so.1, libXrandr.so.2' and had to install desktop libraries by hand before the game would start. From 3.0.2 the launcher ships those libraries itself: every Linux build bundles the exact small X11 client libraries the game's LWJGL/OpenAL natives need (libXcursor, libXrandr, libXxf86vm, libXtst, libXi, libXinerama, libXfixes, libXrender), the pre-launch check runs with the bundle in mind, and PLAY hands the bundled copies straight to the game - no sudo, no terminal, works on any distro. A system that already has these libraries is untouched (its own copies are used; the bundle only fills gaps). If something outside the bundle is still missing - for example the OpenGL driver stack itself - the message still names it with the exact one-line install command for your distro. Windows behavior is unchanged. Everything from 3.0.1/3.0.0 is unchanged: all Minecraft versions with Forge or Fabric, Modrinth + CurseForge mod browser, Modrinth profile import, Microsoft sign-in, cosmetics locker, crash doctor and auto-update.

notes: Kinetrix Client 3.14.0 - LOCKER SECURITY FIX + SKINS WITHOUT LOGIN + CELESTIAL COLLECTION + HD CAPES. Security: a cosmetics session whose Minecraft username changed is now signed out immediately - renaming in the Account Manager can never show another player's locker (you are asked to sign in again). Skins: your skin is fetched straight from the Kinetrix database by your username and shown even when you never sign in to cosmetics - boot, world join, Locker preview and the Skins screen; only uploading/cloud sync still needs an account. New Celestial Collection: 12 new 48-frame animated capes (Eclipse, Zenith, Celestial, Quantum, Mirage, Sapphire, Emerald Dream, Crimson King, Hyperspace, Northern Lights, Solstice, Obsidian) + 4 new auras (Gold, Obsidian, Nebula, Aurora) - the Locker now holds 117 cosmetics. HD capes: every cape re-rendered at 1024x512 with 48-frame loops, crisp on 4K, with a lazy frame loader that keeps your FPS untouched. NOTE: this update is ~102 MB because of the HD cape art - one-time download.
